name: basincycle-selector-aligned-paired-abstention-6x6-v2
purpose: A source-disjoint successor design for the failed Stage-B v1 selector. It preserves the target-free 2/3-cycle proposal generator and strict hard-permutation transition, but trains and selects the same candidate-vs-KEEP safe-improvement and gain heads. This file is not a preregistration, signature, or authorization.

evidence_boundary.diagnosis: The proposal family had useful actions, but inference ignored the trained policy logit and conjoined separately learned q10, pair-loss risk, and a margin against a learned KEEP delta even though true KEEP delta is exactly zero.

implementation.execution_guard: require_signed_execution unconditionally denies every supplied mapping; this scaffold recognises no signed schema and cannot authenticate a transition
implementation.rule: A future separately audited runner must implement fixed-path sidecar/config/hash/transition verification. This unsigned template must never acquire an in-place signature or sidecar.

required_exclusion_groups_at_future_sign.post_design_opened_or_reserved: zero or more, but the named group and provenance attestation are mandatory

required_exclusion_provenance: exact required group-name inventory with no missing or unexpected group
fixed count validation for every historical group
every exclusion filename belongs to the bound organizer-train manifest
per-group ordered filename count and newline SHA-256
exact deduplicated union count and sorted-newline SHA-256
canonical provenance SHA-256 over the complete named inventory
source_protocol.claim_if_materialized: mutually source-disjoint FIT128/calibration32/confirmation32 and disjoint from the complete Stage-B v1 plus frozen warm-start/active protected lineage; not universally untouched against every historical experiment
source_protocol.selection_algorithm: sha256(namespace\0seed\0filename), ascending digest then filename; select all 192 at once after exclusions and partition 128/32/32
required_metadata_receipt: named exclusion-group counts and ordered digests
all three ordered filename lists and digests
fit/calibration/confirmation row counts and plan SHA-256 values
canonical binding-metadata SHA-256 over manifest-name digest, exclusion provenance, roster and plans

corruption_plan.fit_source_schedule: concatenated seeded permutations of FIT128, truncated at 12000 rows; every source occurs 93 or 94 times and each batch contains four distinct sources
corruption_plan.pixel_ranges: must be copied byte-for-byte from the reviewed Stage-B v1 scientific config at future signing
corruption_plan.coherent_equivariance: whole-board transpose/flip only, with directions/layout remapped; no per-tile rotation

architecture.preserved_backbone: BasinCycleStageBMPSReductionsV3 with staged MPS-to-CPU proposal transfer
architecture.preserved_proposal_generator: exact Stage-B v1 target-free proposal closure
architecture.action_input: the existing 491 state/action features plus two compositional changed-edge features
compositional_features: sum over changed bonds of softmax_probability(new contact)-softmax_probability(KEEP contact)
one minus product over removed contacts of one-softmax_probability(KEEP contact)
architecture.compute_scope: same Stage-B v1 analytic convention; excludes fixed preprocessing, normalization, activations, detached CPU proposal closure and backward
architecture.invalid_padding: both outputs negative infinity and never selectable
architecture.strict_output: KEEP or one atomic closed 2/3-cycle of original upright tile positions

fit_labels.proposal_membership: frozen from dirty-visible pair logits before truth attachment
fit_labels.pair_delta: candidate true-pair count minus KEEP true-pair count
fit_labels.loses_existing_true_pair: any true directed pair realised by KEEP is absent in candidate
fit_labels.safe_improvement: valid non-KEEP AND pair_delta>0 AND NOT loses_existing_true_pair
fit_labels.cpu_mechanics: all BxP candidate pair deltas and incumbent-pair-loss flags are attached by vectorized NumPy right/down truth-neighbour tables indexed by directed pair identity (axis, source tile), so an intact pair may move to another raster bond; no proposal-level Python set loop

training.schedule: cosine to zero over exactly 3000 updates
training.hard_negative_rule: for each state and each of three negative strata, retain at most 32 candidates with largest detached compositional expected gain
training.safe_bce: equal mean over every present positive/negative-stratum state group
training.listwise_target: all safe actions attaining maximum true pair gain; KEEP alone if no safe action exists
training.gain_regression: SmoothL1 to integer pair delta on positives plus fixed hard negatives
removed_losses: action policy head not consumed by inference

inference.threshold_origin: zero is the balanced-BCE boundary and analytical KEEP gain; no scored-panel threshold is fitted
inference.abstention: KEEP index zero when no non-KEEP action is eligible

phase_firewall.implementation_status: requirements only; this no-runner scaffold unconditionally denies execution and authenticates none of these transitions
phase_firewall.fit: train on FIT128 only and retain final endpoint only
phase_firewall.calibration_freeze: freeze model, controls, proposal identities, candidates, both trained-head outputs and selected layouts without calibration truth
phase_firewall.calibration_score: attach calibration truth once; apply fixed activation gates; do not modify threshold, loss, architecture, checkpoint or plan
phase_firewall.confirmation_freeze: only after all calibration gates pass, freeze the unchanged endpoint and selector on CONFIRM32 without truth
phase_firewall.confirmation_score: attach confirmation truth exactly once and apply fixed confirmation gates
phase_firewall.forbidden: opening confirmation after calibration fail; reusing old EVAL32; DEV/holdout/terminal/test; any post-open rescue

source_bootstrap.unit: source cluster with both fixed draws

calibration_gates.if_fail: stop this v2 mechanism; do not tune on calibration and do not open confirmation

source_bootstrap.unit: source cluster with both fixed draws

confirmation_gates.if_pass: permits design of a separately signed larger-grid continuation only; no production, submission or competition-test authorization
